try: Open {url}. This demo uses deterministic local providers; no key or model spend.
Send: Decision: keep evidence local. Task: review the release notes. Task: discard the archive.
In Workspace knowledge, confirm the release-notes task and reject the archive task. Leave the decision pending.
Edit the accepted task to Publish reviewed release notes, then choose Kanban and move its Stage to done.
Switch between Summary, Index and Kanban: the same record, evidence and stage stay attached.
Enable Share project board, expand chat under Context sent to models, then ask: What is the latest accepted task?
The deterministic reply names the edited title and done stage. Switch sharing off and ask again to see conversation-only behaviour.
Stop with Ctrl+C, then run npm run demo -- loop --resume to keep accepted records, edits, pending proposals and chat history (use the same demo directory and port shift).
Running npm run demo -- loop again resets this marked throwaway demo. Ctrl+C stops all demo processes.
